channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Prediction markets put Jensen Huang’s odds of returning at 11% on Sunday night—hours later he was back as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Odds flipped within minutes of Nvidia’s announcement, after more than $11 million traded across three related contracts on Kalshi and Polymarket.

item.title: Wall Street just put a $1 trillion price on Jensen Huang as Nvidia stock soars 31% after his return as CEO
item.description: Approximately a quarter of Nvidia’s market cap on Monday came in following Huang’s return announcement.

item.title: Incompetent or pragmatic? Nvidia board’s rehiring of Jensen Huang splits corporate governance experts
item.description: The board must now put in place a succession plan, experts say, even as the decision to rehire Huang leaves 'unanswered questions.'

item.title: Nvidia’s board ousted Jensen Huang for a ‘lack of candor.’ Twelve days later, the same directors brought him back
item.description: Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld has studied boards for five decades and he's never seen one weaker than Nvidia’s.
